images.caption: The post office for w:Shawano, Wisconsin along w:Wisconsin Highway 22, listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

brief: One-storey New Deal-era federal post office in red brick with limestone trim, set up on a raised base: a symmetrical front of tall multi-pane windows in stone surrounds around a central entrance reached by steps with iron railings, a stone frieze with 'UNITED STATES POST OFFICE' lettering and a flat roof behind a stone-coped parapet. A tall flagpole, a lawn strip, shrubs and a blue collection box sit along the street.

facade.notes: the Shawano WI post office (1937): a one-storey red-brick block with limestone coping, belt and window surrounds, a raised base with steps and a long access ramp, an inscribed frieze; a flagpole, a decorative street lamp, a blue mailbox, foundation shrubs

why.note: a civic building is a raised, symmetric block set apart by steps, lawn and a portico
